## Derived files and omissions (2026-11-04)
- `low_poly_-_asian_tower_block_2k.glb` and `low_poly_-_industrial_warehouse_2k.glb`: embedded 8k PNG textures resized to 2048 px (`Tools/glb_downscale_textures.py`); geometry/materials unchanged. The originals (SHA256 above) are not kept in the project (user's Downloads folder only).
- `warehouse_building.glb` (OmegaRedZA) was downloaded but removed: its node scales produced a 4.8 km x 6.6 km bounding box after import and it is not used.
